0:00 | Host | Welcome back to the show — today we are covering a concept that trips up almost everyone the first time they meet it.
0:45 | Host | Here is the core idea, as simply as I can put it: small, consistent steps beat one large effort every time.
2:10 | Host | Let’s walk through a realistic example so this is not just theory.
3:40 | Host | Now, the three mistakes I see most often — and how to sidestep each one.
5:00 | Host | That is the episode. Quick recap, and a pointer to where you can practice this yourself.
